_about: Romanian → English glossary for LOCAL Figma names (components, sets, variant properties/values, component properties, sections, frames, layers, pages) in GEAP 2.0, FOD-Components-flow, eKYC and EVO Cabinet. Visible text (characters) stays Romanian. Applied 2026-10-15 by tools/figma/rename-to-english.js. Full old → new name maps per file: tools/figma/naming-map.json.

conventions.Reperfectare / Prelungire / Duplicat / S: Reissue / Extension / Duplicate / Suspension / Resumption / Withdrawal

rules: Names are split on separators ( · , — , → , / , ( ), „”, «», = , : , -> ) and each segment is translated; separators, IDs (01a, C04, U05h, ek-20), emoji prefixes and code identifiers stay.
Dates: '13 octombrie 2026' → '13 October 2026'. 'Head 12' / '12 head' / 'C07 head' / 'C02·head' translate the word part only.

Kept as-is: product and system names (MPass, MSign, MPay, MConnect, MDocs, MNotify, MPower, RSSP, SRRE, RAP, EVO, GEAP, CAEM, IDNO, IDNP), people, companies, places (Chișinău, Bălți, Anenii Noi…), CSS-class / BEM layer names captured from the prototype (e-permits-…__…), library component names, config keys, e-mails, URLs.
Text layers: renamed only when the name is structural (Label · …, Link · prototip, Titlu notă, Număr, Fișier …) — never when the name is a copy of the content.
Remote library instances with their default name, and every layer inside an instance, are never renamed.
